stops.title: No rest in Troas
stops.text: Paul finds an open door in Troas but has no peace of mind because Titus is not there, so he moves on to Macedonia.

stops.title: Where Titus meets Paul
stops.text: Titus brings good news from Corinth. The Macedonian churches, though poor, give generously to the collection.

stops.title: The church in Corinth
stops.text: Paul has visited painfully, written severely, and now plans a third visit.

stops.title: The collection for the poor
stops.text: The gift from the Gentile churches is meant for the saints in Jerusalem.

stops.title: The escape in a basket
stops.text: Among the stories of his weakness, Paul recalls escaping Damascus in a basket through a window in the wall.
